protocol.selection: 100 calibration scenes: ten targets x states 1..10; plus all 12 localization-ready new-object captures
protocol.system_prompt: Associate one semantic target with an already-localized candidate. Follow the requested output format.
protocol.none_policy: known-present, valid candidate letters only; identical within every pair
protocol.pair_order: alternate by fixed pair index; each pair runs sequentially, at most four pairs concurrently
protocol.score: raw generated decision-label likelihood; explanation and alternatives are diagnostic-only
protocol.analysis: separate cohort accuracy/AUC/distributions, paired transitions and exactly matched threshold coverage; pooled descriptive result; no threshold selection or held-out claims
protocol.visual_input: existing direct letters for state scenes; only crop-header labels changed on new-object sheets, with non-label pixel equality verified; both arms receive identical bytes
